The failing test `testLang294` in the `StrBuilderTest` class creates a `StrBuilder` instance with the content `"\n%BLAH%\nDo more stuff\neven more stuff\n%BLAH%\n"`. It then calls the `deleteAll` method on this `StrBuilder` instance to delete all occurrences of `"\n%BLAH%"`.

The current bug report mentions that `StrBuilder.replaceAll` and `StrBuilder.deleteAll` can throw `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException`. This indicates a potential issue with index manipulation or boundary checking within the `deleteAll` method of `StrBuilder`.
